title: In-Flight Tool-Call Stream Normalization & AST Auto-Repair

claims.assertion: Streaming tool execution engines must intercept plain-text model codeblocks (JSON fences, XML <tool_call> tags) and auto-repair syntax defects in-flight (trailing commas, unclosed brackets) before propagating to execution dispatch.

context: Non-fine-tuned models frequently emit markdown code fences or unescaped XML tool calls in plain text streams. Strict JSON-RPC parsers crash unless streaming intercepts normalize payloads before dispatch.
